arxiv-2009-12959.creator: Yihong Du, Alejandro Gárriz, and Fernando Quirós
arxiv-2009-12959.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yihong Du, Alejandro Gárriz, and Fernando Quirós. We study a family of reaction-diffusion equations that present a doubly nonlinear character given by a combination of the p p -Laplacian and the porous medium operators. We consider the so-called slow diffusion regime, corresponding to a degenerate behaviour at the level 0, in which nonnegative solutions with compactly supported initial data have a compact support for any later time.

arxiv-2109-14174.title: Cross-Camera Human Motion Transfer by Time Series Analysis
arxiv-2109-14174.creator: Yaping Zhao, Guanghan Li, Edmund Y. Lam
arxiv-2109-14174.description: Abstract With advances in optical sensor technology, heterogeneous camera systems are increasingly used for high-resolution (HR) video acquisition and analysis. However, motion transfer across multiple cameras poses challenges. To address this, we propose an algorithm based on time series analysis that identifies motion seasonality and constructs an additive model to extract transferable patterns.

arxiv-2207-06132.description: Abstract . We consider a class of semi-Markov processes (SMP) such that the embedded discrete time Markov chain may be non-homogeneous. The corresponding augmented processes are represented as semi-martingales using stochastic integral equation involving a Poisson random measure. The existence and uniqueness of the equation are established.

arxiv-2211-15216.title: Interstitial segregation has the potential to mitigate liquid metal embrittlement in iron
arxiv-2211-15216.creator: Ahmadian, A, Scheiber, D, Zhou, X, Gault, B, Romaner, L, Darvishi Kamachali, R, Ecker, W, Dehm, G, Liebscher, C. H
arxiv-2211-15216.description: Abstract The embrittlement of metallic alloys by liquid metals leads to catastrophic material failure and severely impacts their structural integrity. The weakening of grain boundaries by the ingress of liquid metal and preceding segregation in the solid are thought to promote early fracture.

arxiv-2306-00022.title: Ephemeris Updates for Seven Selected HATNet Survey Transiting Exoplanets 2023 Ephemeris Updates for Seven Selected HATNet Survey Transiting Exoplanets – References
arxiv-2306-00022.creator: A. Poro, F. Ahangarani Farahani, E. Jahangiri, A. Sarostad, M. Gozarandi, M. Haghgou, F. Abolhassani, A. Fakhrabadi, Y. Jongen, A. Wünsche, R. Naves, P. Guerra, A. Marchini, M. Salisbury, R. Ehrenberger, V-P. Hentunen

Wünsche, R. Naves, P. Guerra, A. Marchini, M. Salisbury, R. Ehrenberger, V-P. Hentunen. We refined the ephemeris of seven transiting exoplanets HAT-P-6b, HAT-P-12b, HAT-P-18b, HAT-P-22b, HAT-P-32b, HAT-P-33b, and HAT-P-52b. We observed 11 transits from eight observatories in different filters for HAT-P-6b and HAT-P-32b.

arxiv-2306-05784.title: Quantitative Ink Analysis: Estimating the Number of Inks in Documents through Hyperspectral Imaging
arxiv-2306-05784.creator: Aneeqa Abrar, Hamza Iqbal
arxiv-2306-05784.description: Abstract In the field of document forensics, ink analysis plays a crucial role in determining the authenticity of legal and historic documents and detecting forgery. Visual examination alone is insufficient for distinguishing visually similar inks, necessitating the use of advanced scientific techniques.

arxiv-2312-13362.title: Entanglement smectic and stripe order
arxiv-2312-13362.creator: Nilotpal Chakraborty, Roderich Moessner, Benoit Doucot
arxiv-2312-13362.description: Abstract Spontaneous symmetry breaking and more recently entanglement are two cornerstones of quantum matter. We introduce the notion of anisotropic entanglement ordered phases, where the spatial profile of spin-pseudospin entanglement spontaneously lowers the four-fold rotational symmetry of the underlying crystal to a two-fold one, while the charge density retains the full symmetry.

arxiv-2407-07560.title: Instrumentation and Analysis of Native ML Pipelines via Logical Query Plans
arxiv-2407-07560.creator: Stefan Grafberger
arxiv-2407-07560.description: Abstract . Machine Learning (ML) is increasingly used to automate impactful decisions, which leads to concerns regarding their correctness, reliability, and fairness. We envision highly-automated software platforms to assist data scientists with developing, validating, monitoring, and analysing their ML pipelines.

arxiv-2410-17305.title: Gas-induced perturbations on the gravitational wave in-spiral of live post-Newtonian LISA massive black hole binaries
arxiv-2410-17305.creator: Mudit Garg, Alessia Franchini, Alessandro Lupi, Matteo Bonetti, Lucio Mayer
arxiv-2410-17305.description: Abstract We investigate the effect of dynamically coupling gas torques with gravitational wave (GW) emission during the orbital evolution of an equal-mass massive black hole binary (MBHB). We perform hydrodynamical simulations of eccentric MBHBs with total mass M = 10 6 ​ M ☉ M=10^{6}~{\rm M}_{\sun} embedded in a prograde locally isothermal circumbinary disk (CBD).

arxiv-2506-02273.title: Particle-in-Cell Simulations of Burning ICF Capsule Implosions
arxiv-2506-02273.creator: Johannes J. van de Wetering, Justin R. Angus, W. Farmer, V. Geyko, D. Ghosh, D. Grote, C. Weber, G. Zimmerman
arxiv-2506-02273.description: Abstract Anomalies observed in the neutron spectral shift of high-yield shots at the National Ignition Facility (NIF) suggest the presence of suprathermal ions Hartouni et al. 2023 , implying that kinetic effects play a significant role in burning inertial confinement fusion (ICF) plasmas.

arxiv-2506-18858.title: Universality and non-differentiability: A new perspective on angular dispersion in optics
arxiv-2506-18858.creator: Layton A. Hall, Murat Yessenov, Kenneth L. Schepler, Ayman F. Abouraddy
arxiv-2506-18858.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Layton A. Hall, Murat Yessenov, Kenneth L. Schepler, Ayman F. Abouraddy. Angular dispersion (AD) is a ubiquitous phenomenon in optics after light traverses a diffractive or dispersive device, whereby each wavelength propagates at a different angle. AD is useful in a variety of applications; for example, modifying the group velocity or group-velocity dispersion of pulsed lasers in free space or optical materials, which are essential ingredients in group-velocity matching and dispersion compensation.

arxiv-2507-04573.title: A new characterization of the weakly Laskerian (FSF) modules
arxiv-2507-04573.creator: Ali Fathi
arxiv-2507-04573.description: Abstract . Let R R be a commutative Noetherian ring and M M be an R R -module such that the set of associated prime ideals of the quotient module M / L M/L is finite for all submodules L L of M M .

arxiv-2510-07914.title: Effects of magnetic fields on spinning test particles orbiting Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson black holes
arxiv-2510-07914.creator: Yu-Kun Zhang 1,2,3 , Shao-Wen Wei 1,2,3
arxiv-2510-07914.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the kinematic effects of spinning test particles orbiting the Kerr-Bertotti-Robinson black hole. Employing with the Mathisson-Papapetrou-Dixon equations, we explore the dynamics of precessing orbits and distinct orbital types, including circular orbits and innermost stable circular orbits.

arxiv-2512-21484.title: Viability of Sub-TeV Higgsino Dark Matter with Slepton Coannihilation
arxiv-2512-21484.creator: Yuanfang Yue, Yuetao Wang
arxiv-2512-21484.description: Abstract The higgsino-like neutralino is a compelling dark matter candidate motivated by both cosmology and naturalness considerations. While a pure higgsino typically requires a mass of around 1.1 ​ TeV 1.1~\mathrm{TeV} to satisfy the observed thermal relic abundance, the presence of light sleptons can significantly alter this requirement.

After serving in the army abroad, he was employed in 1551 in negotiating a marriage between Edward VI.

pmc-10717857.title: Lived experience narratives in health professional education: educators’ perspectives of a co-designed, online mental health education resource
pmc-10717857.creator: Tracey Parnell, Kate Fiske, Kellie Stastny, Sarah Sewell, Melissa Nott
pmc-10717857.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionMeaningful involvement of people with lived experience is an invaluable approach to education that facilitates the development of knowledge, skills and attitudes for collaborative, compassionate and person-centred healthcare practice. The purpose of this evaluation was to gain health professional educators’ perspectives of an online learning resource that presents the lived experiences of people who have been consumers of the Australian mental health system.MethodsA cross sectional study design was used to survey educators who had registered to use the online education resource.

pmc-11476409.title: New Insights on Chromosome Diversification in Malagasy Chameleons
pmc-11476409.creator: Marcello Mezzasalma, Gaetano Odierna, Rachele Macirella, Elvira Brunelli
pmc-11476409.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryChromosome diversification represents a fundamental driver of biological evolution. Here we present and discuss the results of a comparative chromosome analysis on different species of the Malagasy chameleons of the genera Brookesia and Furcifer. We show that the study species are characterized by different karyotypes in terms of chromosome number (2n = 36–22), ratio of micro- and macrochromosomes, and the variable presence of differentiated sex chromosomes.

pmc-11606088.title: Genetic-by-age interaction analyses on complex traits in UK Biobank and their potential to identify effects on longitudinal trait change
pmc-11606088.creator: Thomas W. Winkler, Simon Wiegrebe, Janina M. Herold, Klaus J. Stark, Helmut Küchenhoff, Iris M. Heid
pmc-11606088.description: BackgroundGenome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified thousands of loci for disease-related human traits in cross-sectional data. However, the impact of age on genetic effects is underacknowledged. Also, identifying genetic effects on longitudinal trait change has been hampered by small sample sizes for longitudinal data. Such effects on deteriorating trait levels over time or disease progression can be clinically relevant.

pmc-11611938.title: Risk of pneumonia among children with cleft palate before and after palatoplasty: a population-based study
pmc-11611938.creator: Yotam Eyni, Tomer Kerman, Dana Danino, Aviv Goldbart, Eldad Silberstein
pmc-11611938.description: Pneumonia remains the primary cause of mortality among children under age 5. Cleft palate (CP) poses various challenges including velopharyngeal disfunction, potentially increasing rates of pneumonia. However, clinical evidence linking pneumonia to defect is lacking. This study aims to assess the prevalence of pneumonia and lower respiratory tract infections (LRTI) among CP patients through a population-based approach.

pmc-11667162.title: Identification and validation of lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD)-associated targets for monascin from the extracts of Monascus purpureus-fermented rice: Compound preparation, high-throughput genome sequencing and bioinformatics analysis
pmc-11667162.creator: Xilinqiqige Bao, Hanqing Li, Jiayin Xu, Xiaoqing Liu, Runa A, Jianming Chen, Fengzheng Chen, Nan Ya, Rigula Sa
pmc-11667162.description: Despite the remarkable bioactivities exhibited by monascin against several tumors, its therapeutic targets remain unexplored. In this study, our objective is to identify therapeutic targets based on the antitumor activity of monascin against lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) A549 cells. The compound monascin was derived from extracts of Monascus purpureus-fermented rice.

pmc-11669788.title: Realising the potential of participatory research in youth mental health: Time to go back to basics
pmc-11669788.creator: Lucy Biddle, Zoë Haime
pmc-11669788.description: The importance of embedding participatory methods within youth mental health research is well accepted and often a funding prerequisite. However, we argue that there is a need to revisit the core values of the approach in order to ensure that participatory methods remain meaningful, effective and authentic.

pmc-12480164.title: HIV/AIDS Notifications in Korea, 2023
pmc-12480164.creator: Koun Kim, Sungnam Kim, Taeyoung Kim, Jeonghee Yu, 고운 김, 성남 김, 태영 김, 정희 유
pmc-12480164.description: This report is the result of the analysis of data on human immunodeficiency virus (HIV)-positive cases reported in the year 2023. In 2023, 1,005 new cases of HIV infection were reported in the Republic of Korea. Of these, 749 people (74.5%) were Koreans and 256 (25.5%) were foreigners. Men accounted for 903 (89.9 %) of the total cases.

pmc-12655551.title: Design, Synthesis, and Evaluation of Pyrrole-Based Selective MAO-B Inhibitors with Additional AChE Inhibitory and Neuroprotective Properties Identified via Virtual Screening
pmc-12655551.creator: Emilio Mateev, Samir Chtita, Ekaterina Pavlova, Ali Irfan, Diana Tzankova, Shubham Sharma, Borislav Georgiev, Alexandrina Mateeva, Georgi Momekov, Maya Georgieva, Alexander Zlatkov, Magdalena Kondeva-Burdina
pmc-12655551.description: Background: Virtual screening is a widely adopted technique for the discovery of novel pharmacologically active compounds; however, the risk of identifying false positive hits remains a major challenge. Aim: The aim of this study was to perform a validated structure-based drug design screening to discover multitarget pyrrole-based molecules as selective dual-acting monoamine oxidase (MAO) and acetylcholinesterase (AChE) inhibitors.

pmc-12743519.title: P2-HNF4α alters linoleic acid metabolism and mitigates soybean oil-induced obesity: role for oxylipins
pmc-12743519.creator: Poonamjot Deol, Johannes Fahrmann, Dmitry Grapov, Jun Yang, Jane R. Evans, Oliver Fiehn, Brett Phinney, Bruce D. Hammock, Frances M. Sladek
pmc-12743519.description: Oxylipins—oxidized metabolites of polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs)—are associated with several pathological conditions. We previously showed that oxylipin metabolites of linoleic acid (LA) and alpha-linolenic acid positively correlate with obesity in wild-type (WT) mice fed a high fat diet (35% kcal fat) based on soybean oil (SO).

pmc-13197694.title: A rare and severe case of toxic megacolon: Radiological emergency
pmc-13197694.creator: Salma Abddaimi, Hicham Benramdane, Adnane Boubacar, Hamid Ziani, Siham Nasri, Imane Kamaoui, Imane Skiker
pmc-13197694.description: Toxic megacolon is a rare and life-threatening complication of ulcerative colitis, representing a medical and surgical emergency with a poor prognosis.We report the case of a 31-year-old man with no significant past medical history, admitted for a 15-day history of bloody mucoid diarrhea associated with general health deterioration.

pmc-13248633.title: Draft genome of Escherichia coli 546 with toxigenic potential, an epizootic important pathogenic isolate obtained from a sick piglet
pmc-13248633.creator: Alexander S. Tishchenko, Sergey V. Kopyltsov, Artem P. Sedashev, Nadejda L. Machneva, Sviatoslav V. Fedorovich, Anastasia V. Elisiutikova
pmc-13248633.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The toxigenic Escherichia coli strain 546 was isolated from the tubular bone of a 10-day-old sick piglet. Genetic analysis revealed the presence of toxin-encoding genes, indicating the strain’s potential as a component for improving porcine vaccines. ANNOUNCEMENT

Due to the role of toxigenic Escherichia coli in piglet escherichiosis (1), the identification of toxin genes in an isolated strain suggests its potential as a source of vaccine antigens (2).

pmc-13411673.title: Evolution of Hip Arthroscopy in Modern Orthopedic Practice
pmc-13411673.creator: Muhammad Yamaan Khan, Raaed Khan, Hani Shaikh, Nadiya A Persaud, Sapna Rama

pmc-13414959.title: Autoprobiotic Supplements Attenuate Obesity and Improve Gut Microbiota, Carbohydrate, and Lipid Metabolism in Patients with Metabolic Syndrome: A Pilot Trial
pmc-13414959.creator: Elena Ermolenko, Stanislav Sitkin, Lyubov Alferova, Nadezhda Novikova, Nikita Gladyshev, Victoria Orlova, Alena Zalicheva, Elena Demchenko, Oleg Ergashev, Alexander Suvorov
pmc-13414959.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: A pilot study was conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of treatment with autoprobiotic bacteria from indigenous, non-pathogenic Enterococcus faecium and Enterococcus hirae strains in patients with metabolic syndrome (MetS). Methods: Fifty patients with MetS (sex-matched, aged 42–63 years) were randomized to an experimental group (Ap, n = 26) that received autoprobiotics grown in nutritional mix SuproPlus 2640 and a control group (Pl, n = 24) that received SuproPlus 2640 for 20 days.

pmc-13458487.title: Comparative evaluation of CNN models for nasopharyngeal carcinoma classification on pathology data
pmc-13458487.creator: Muhammad Kabir Abdullahi, Sarina Mansor, Wan Siti Halimatul Munirah Wan Ahmad, Md Serajun Nabi, Mohammad Faizal Ahmad Fauzi, Arbab Sufyan Wadood, Adam Malik Ismail
pmc-13458487.description: This study presents a systematic evaluation of deep learning models for the classification of nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) using whole slide images (WSIs) obtained from Sarawak General Hospital (SGH) and Hospital Kuala Lumpur (HKL). NPC, a malignancy with high prevalence in Southeast Asia, presents diagnostic challenges due to the histological similarities between normal and pathological tissues.

pmc-13491545.title: Non-bronchial systemic arteries in massive hemoptysis secondary to pulmonary tuberculosis: risk factors and outcomes of embolization materials. A retrospective observational study
pmc-13491545.creator: Jingqiang Wu, Deqing Liu, Muhammad Tahir Khan, Peng Zhong, Yili Wang, Yongyong Le, Hongzhi Yang, Hui Zhang
pmc-13491545.description: ObjectivesTo investigate the distribution characteristics, independent risk factors of non-bronchial systemic arteries (NBSA) in patients with pulmonary tuberculosis.MethodsA retrospective analysis was performed using clinical data of 91 patients (75 males and 16 females) with pulmonary tuberculosis complicated by massive hemoptysis who underwent bronchial artery embolization (BAE).

pmc-13552118.title: Desiccation tolerance as a driver of environmental persistence and transmission in nosocomial bacterial pathogens
pmc-13552118.creator: Michael J. Bucher, Alejandro Rivera-Madera, Erin R. Green
pmc-13552118.description: Hospital-acquired infections (HAIs) represent a major global health burden, leading to increased patient morbidity, mortality, and healthcare costs. These infections frequently occur following patient contact with microbial pathogens persisting on indwelling devices and other abiotic surfaces in the hospital environment.

pmc-13600080.title: Aging as Loss of Biological Self-Correction: A Geroscience Framework for Longevity, Inflammaging, and Restored Resilience
pmc-13600080.creator: David Bar-Or, Jason Williams, Daniel Paredes
pmc-13600080.description: Longevity science has shifted from the pursuit of lifespan extension toward preservation of healthspan, resilience, and functional independence. The hallmarks of aging provide a powerful descriptive structure, but they do not by themselves specify how diverse molecular defects translate into loss of adaptive function.
